note: Where Folio is headed. Plans can change with feedback, and Android doesn't allow everything iOS does.

sections.subtitle: Your language, your Home, and Smooth

items.title: More dock apps
items.detail: The dock grows from four to six apps as you fill it.

items.title: Clear badges when opened
items.detail: Optionally hide an app's badge once you open it.

items.title: StandBy without the fold
items.detail: StandBy as a screen saver, so it turns on while the phone charges instead of only when it is set down half open. Chosen in Android’s Settings › Display › Screen saver.

items.title: Flipbook
items.detail: Home pages turn in 3D as you swipe, inspired by Barrel. Supporters have it in the Market now, and everyone gets it in 0.6.8.

items.title: Duet
items.detail: The fold animation as a tweak, with six looks including iPhone Duo. Based on Duo Fold Live.

items.title: Your own search engine
items.detail: Bing, Brave, Ecosia and more, or any address you type.

items.title: Language in Settings
items.detail: Choose Folio's language in Settings › General, with more of Folio in Korean and Chinese.

items.title: A shorter Settings list
items.detail: Ten fewer rows on the first screen: a General page for what you open once, and one Support Folio row.

items.title: Cleaner widget picker
items.detail: Find a widget without scrolling past one app's hundreds: a row of app icons narrows the gallery to the one you want, and each app shows a single row until you ask for more.

items.title: Faster Folio
items.detail: Home and the App Library are ready sooner after Folio starts.

items.title: Layout History
items.detail: Out of beta: go back to how Home looked before a big change.

items.title: Supporters, and a badge that lasts
items.detail: Back Folio with $15 or more for a Folio Supporter badge that stays, and your name in Settings › Supporters if you want it.

items.title: Folio Beta in the Market
items.detail: Supporters update Folio to the newest beta from the Market, checked against Folio's signing key.

items.title: Panes that fit the screen
items.detail: The Market and Settings use two panes on a Fold's inner screen, like iPad, and never leave one empty.

items.title: Double tap on Home
items.detail: Your Double Tap action works again on an empty spot, whatever size your grid is.

items.title: The dock steps aside
items.detail: Swipe to Today View and the dock leaves, so it can't sit over the widgets or take their taps.

items.title: Icons follow your theme
items.detail: A theme that changes app icons shows straight away, and Icons & Side Bar has Refresh Icons for the rest.

items.title: No more smeared pages
items.detail: Choosing Android's wallpaper draws cleanly instead of leaving every swipe painted over the last.

items.title: A way back in Settings
items.detail: Every page has a way back, and the Preview bar no longer covers the App Library.

items.title: Real art behind Home
items.detail: Two Hiroshige prints ship with Folio, and Wallpaper & Appearance is one grid of your photo, Folio's art and the art you install, each with its artist and license.

items.title: Folio speaks Korean
items.detail: A community translation, in beta until a native speaker reviews it.

items.title: White text on a pale wallpaper
items.detail: Home darkens a little at the top and bottom so the clock and app names stay readable.

items.title: Folio Market
items.detail: A Sileo-style store for themes, tweaks and layouts, with Featured, Sources, Packages, Installed and Settings.

items.title: Community sources
items.detail: Add sources from GitHub. Every source is signed, and nothing is downloaded unless you add it.

items.title: Privacy labels
items.detail: See what a package can use before you get it.

items.title: Make your own tweaks
items.detail: A package format, sample and tools so anyone can publish themes and tweaks.

items.title: Your language
items.detail: Folio follows your phone's language, and on Android 13 and later you can pick one just for Folio.

items.title: Simplified Chinese
items.detail: Folio in 简体中文, from setup to the Market, with Traditional Chinese to follow.

items.title: Search in pinyin
items.detail: Find apps by pinyin or initials, and without typing accents.

items.title: Help translate
items.detail: A public way to add a language or fix a translation on GitHub.

items.title: Better bug reports
items.detail: Folio notes freezes and unexpected restarts, and Report a Bug can copy diagnostics for you.

items.title: Status spacing
items.detail: Bring the time and date closer, and turn off the status background.

items.title: Folder fixes
items.detail: No duplicate folders when unfolded, and folders move again.

items.title: Automatic updates
items.detail: Updates install while your phone is idle, with release notes, Update Now and Update Tonight.

items.title: Clear icons
items.detail: Frosted glass icons with white symbols, like iOS.

items.title: Big Clock
items.detail: A large clock on Home with the date, next event and alarm.

items.title: Folder badges
items.detail: Folders show how many notifications their apps have.

items.title: Dock and status position
items.detail: Choose the Side Bar or the bottom for the dock, and move the status to the top, on each screen.

items.title: Try Folio first
items.detail: Open Folio from your current Home Screen to try it before making it your Home app.

items.title: More rows
items.detail: Home adds rows where your screen has room, the same on both screens of a foldable.

items.title: Layout sliders
items.detail: Space between rows, columns and dock apps, widget size and status spacing, and Home shows each change as you drag.

items.title: Small cover screens
items.detail: A focused Home for tiny flip-phone cover screens.

items.title: Fold-aware Home
items.detail: Pages, the dock and the status stay off the hinge when you half fold.

items.title: Tweak Library
items.detail: Get the tweaks you want; only those show in Settings.

items.title: Software Update
items.detail: Update Folio from GitHub, with optional notifications.

items.title: Island notifications
items.detail: Other apps' notifications in the Dynamic Island, for the apps you choose.

items.title: Status styles
items.detail: Rings and Ring with Percentage in the Side Bar, and a Silent mode icon.

items.title: Rounded corners
items.detail: Optional iPhone Duo-style corners on Home.

items.title: Badge styles
items.detail: iOS, Classic or Glass badges in three sizes.

items.title: Headphones card
items.detail: An iPhone-style card when headphones or a speaker connects.

items.title: Focus that turns on by itself
items.detail: A Focus can turn on when the phone is unfolded, charging or has headphones, and off when that stops.

items.title: Folders you can shape
items.detail: Resize a folder by its corner, drop an app on another to make one, and sort A to Z.

items.title: Make the Big Clock your own
items.detail: Looks, a color, Fine tune and Place Freely.

items.title: Drag the dock
items.detail: A handle in edit mode moves the Side Bar dock up and down.

items.title: Bottom of Home and stronger rings
items.detail: Choose a Search button, Page dots or Nothing, and thicker status rings.

items.title: Even rows under a widget
items.detail: A widget at the top of a page fills exactly two rows, so the dock lines up.

items.title: The Market keeps itself current
items.detail: Add a source from a GitHub address, and refresh, notices and automatic updates, all off until you turn them on, with Undo and an Updated recently list.

items.title: What Folio can use, and what it did
items.detail: Capabilities and Recent Activity in Settings › Advanced, and Copy Diagnostics.

items.title: System Bridge
items.detail: One switch for everything that reaches past a normal app, with an optional root hinge angle.

items.title: A setup that asks where you are from
items.detail: iPhone or Android start, a navigation page, and Keep Things as They Are.

items.title: What to Test
items.detail: A checklist for beta testers, with a way to report what is wrong.

items.title: Safe Mode that recovers
items.detail: An install cut short is put back, and native crashes and freezes count toward Safe Mode.

items.title: Notices with Undo
items.detail: Notices that fit their text and stay clear of the camera and fold, and Undo from the update notice.

items.title: Smoother swiping
items.detail: Less redrawing while apps install and when offline; the swipe itself comes next, measured on the Fold8.

items.title: Icon Actions
items.detail: Tap, long press, double tap and swipes on a Home icon, each set to an action you choose.

items.title: The Market for everyone
items.detail: Packages say what they may change, and anything unknown is held back until you allow it.

items.title: A record of what packages did
items.detail: An audit list on your phone, with package health and a quarantine for ones that misbehave.

items.title: Page effects from the Market
items.detail: New Flipbook effects arrive as packages.

items.title: Community Tweaks built in
items.detail: Folio's own tweaks come from the Market too, so they update like any package.

items.title: Edit Layout on Home
items.detail: Adjust icons, rows, spacing, the dock and the status right on your Home Screen.

items.title: Home grid columns
items.detail: Four, five or six columns on Home.

items.title: Custom app icons
items.detail: Pick any app's icon from an icon pack or a photo.

items.title: Icon Stacks
items.detail: A stack of icons built on folders.

items.title: Simple Mode
items.detail: Large, clear buttons with labels, a Home that can't be moved by accident, and only the settings you need.

items.title: Weather widget
items.detail: A glass widget with the hourly forecast. Off until you turn it on, since it needs a weather service.

items.title: Back Tap
items.detail: Double or triple tap the back of your phone to run an action. Inspired by RegiStar.

items.title: Notification Rules
items.detail: Choose per app where notifications show.

items.title: Dock Drawer
items.detail: Swipe in on the dock for recent apps and Now Playing.

items.title: Complications
items.detail: A second time zone, sunset and your next alarm on the Lock Cover and StandBy.

items.title: More privacy controls
items.detail: Private Space support, and more ways to keep what's on your screen private, planned for 0.8.0.

items.title: Custom Today View
items.detail: Arrange Today View your way, with a news feed like the page left of Android's Home.

items.title: Corners everywhere
items.detail: Rounded screen corners over every app, not just Home.

items.title: Lock Designer
items.detail: Design your own Lock Cover and StandBy for each screen.

items.title: Folio website
items.detail: Downloads, docs, the Market and the roadmap on the web.

items.title: Folio account
items.detail: Optional, never required: sign in to keep supporter perks, Discord and Google in one place.

items.title: Apps in the Market
items.detail: Icon packs and themes from Play Store, F-Droid and Obtainium, plus layouts from other launchers, all from the Folio Market.

items.title: The Folio app
items.detail: A Sileo-style app for tweaks, themes and updates, with Settings as one tab. The Tweak Library is the first piece.

items.title: Enhanced Fold Tracking
items.detail: Samsung's precise hinge angle for a smoother fold, set up once with Wireless Debugging. Based on research by ZFoldDuo.

items.title: Keyd
items.detail: A keyboard that reads the window: it splits around the crease of a fold, every key can answer a swipe, and it asks for no internet permission. Supporters with a keyboard code see it first.

items.title: Community themes
items.detail: Browse and add themes shared on GitHub, right from Folio.

items.title: Folio Tweaks
items.detail: Tweaks made by the community, if it can be done safely.

items.title: Apple services
items.detail: Join FaceTime links and open Find Devices from Folio. Deeper options only as optional integrations.
